newsitem.title: CANADA: Labatt Brewing launches specialty beer subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Labatt Brewing launches specialty beer subsidiary.

text.p: Canadian brewer Labatt Brewing Co said on Friday it launched a subsidiary to brew and market regional Canadian beers and well-known international brands.
Oland Speciality Beer Co will be based in Toronto amd market a range of foreign beers, including Guinness Extra Stout, Dos Equis XX and Sol, Tuborg, Michelob, and Boddington's Pub Ale, Labatt said.

Labatt is Canada's second largest brewer and a subsidiary of Belgian beermaker Interbew SA. Oland Speciality will use the facilities of Halifax, Nova Scotia-based Oland Brewing, which will spend C$9 million to upgrade its operations.
Luc Guens, a member of Interbrew's Belgian executive committee, was appointed president of Oland Speciality Beer Co effective immediately.

"Having seen the success of Labatt's speciality beer company in the (United States), we're looking forward to providing the same kind of superior service, sales and promotional focus to this important segment in Canada," Guens said.
